title: Eleven Rows and One Crow
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：corn　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 corn 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather ① planted a corn that the seed merchant could not name, and he said the planting was the whole of the spring. The ② corn, meaning the crop and not the seed, ran to eleven rows and stayed that width; corn, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how many rows survive the crow.

Every ③ corn in that valley had the same planting day, and the ④ corn at the end, meaning the one he kept for the mill and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed twice. Corn, my grandmother said, is nine parts planting day and one part somebody willing to wait; my grandfather said the waiting is the part that fills eleven rows.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the corn was the whole of the complaint, meaning the soreness and not the crop. The ⑥ corn, meaning the soreness and not any of that, is the only thing on a foot that everybody mentions and nobody shows; corn, she said, is either something you plant or the only word that means both a crop and a soreness. He said the soreness is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ corn had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the planting day. The ⑧ corn of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in May, was one field and thirty years of waiting; corn, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to weigh it. She said the weighing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ corn I remember is the one at the end, which he cut in 1971 and is still described as the heaviest in the county. A ⑩ corn, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being waited for; every corn, she said, is a soreness that has agreed to look like a crop. She said the soreness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 玉米（指那片庄稼本身，与那些种子相对）
C. 固定搭配：plant a corn 种下一片玉米
D. n. 玉米（指那个山谷里每一片）
E. n. 玉米（指末尾那一片）
F. n. 鸡眼；脚部的硬结
G. n. 玉米（指账本里提到的那一片）
H. n. 谷物；庄稼（抽象总称）

items.q: planted a corn that the seed merchant could not name
The corn, meaning the crop and not the seed

answers.why: plant a corn 意为“种下一片玉米”，1957 年祖父种下了一片种子商叫不出名字的玉米。
corn 意为“玉米”，指那片庄稼本身而不是那些种子，种了十一垄。
corn 指那个山谷里每一片玉米，每一片都在同一天下种。
corn 指末尾那一片（他留给磨坊的那一片），是唯一有人称过两次的。
corn 意为“鸡眼”，母亲说鸡眼就是那句抱怨的全部，指的是脚上的硬结而不是那片庄稼。
corn 为另一个义项，指脚上的鸡眼而不是那片庄稼，是脚上人人都提起、却无人给人看的东西。
corn 意为“玉米”，指账本里提到的那一片，到 1965 年这片玉米成了账本里的一行。
corn 意为“谷物、庄稼”，祖父五月写道，整件事的庄稼是一片地三十年的等待。
corn 意为“玉米”，我记得的是末尾那一片，他 1971 年收割，至今仍被说成全县最重的。
corn 为抽象总称，祖母说一片玉米是唯一会因为被等待而变好的东西。
